cli

CRAN 3.6.6

CRAN 3.6.6. The exported functions are translated, including the builtin theme, hashes of serialized objects, emoji and animal names, the tree, the diff, syntax highlighting, and the non-interactive progress and keypress behavior. There is no Fortran, so there is no crate.
